label: The nine give every typed Dei Filius attribute, LORD_1, BLESSED_1 via LORD_2, BLESSED_2 (inference)
rule: Composition of the registered nineGiveDeiFilius without its lord and most-blessed bridges, on primitives whose IsLord is creator of all and whose MostBlessed is perfection with intellect, then LORD_2, BLESSED_2 and the two sense bridges at the same being
meaning: At any being g with the nine, the registered nineGiveDeiFilius (result of argument 1fa790f2) is applied with every input except 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is lord of everything else' and 'Whatever is PERFECT_2 and HAS_INTELLECT_1 is most blessed', on the primitives that agree with the given ones except that their IsLord is IsCreatorOfAll and their MostBlessed is perfection with intellect; those two bridges then hold trivially and nothing about the given IsLord and MostBlessed is used, and every conjunct except lord and blessed is carried over. g is LORD_2 and BLESSED_2 (the two nine-statements), so the sense bridges give g LORD_1 and BLESSED_1. The senses are not identified: each passage is one listed bridge premise. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
